lines.english: Gratitude for this return. Gratitude for my other self. An apology to the world.

lines.japanese: そして僕は、秘められた園で、隠遁を約束する。
lines.english: And in that secret garden, I vowed to live in seclusion.

lines.japanese: 「ただいま」
lines.english: “I'm home.”

lines.japanese: 四人は顔を見合わせ、そして一斉に、
lines.english: The four exchanged glances, and then, all at once—

lines.japanese: 「おかえりなさい―――」
lines.english: “Welcome home—”

lines.japanese: 「おかえりなさい―――」
lines.english: “Welcome home—”

lines.japanese: 「おかえりなさい―――」
lines.english: “Welcome home—”

lines.japanese: 「おかえりなさい―――」
lines.english: “Welcome home—”

lines.japanese: 「……戻ったか、貴宮忍」
lines.english: “…So you've returned, Shinobu Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「どうします？」
lines.english: “What do we do?”

lines.japanese: 「放置しておいて良いでしょうか？」
lines.english: “Can we safely leave him alone?”

lines.japanese: 「検査しても、凡人が一人いるだけでしょうがね」
lines.english: “An examination would probably find nothing but an ordinary man.”

lines.japanese:
「しかし我らの本当の王は、脳腫瘍だったんでしょ
　うか」
lines.english: “Still, was our true King really a brain tumor?”

lines.japanese: 「……あの子は、結局、忍を助けたんです」
lines.english: “…In the end, she saved Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「信じられないことですけどね……
　腫瘍に人格があるなどと」
lines.english: “It's difficult to believe… that a tumor could possess a personality.”

lines.japanese:
「我々も最後までその存在を確認することはできま
　せんでした」
lines.english: “Even we were unable to confirm its existence to the very end.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ……ネットの件といい、忍の特異性といい、
　あまりにも偶発が多すぎました」
lines.english: “But… between the network and Shinobu's peculiarities, there were simply too many coincidences.”

lines.japanese:
「あの子がいなければ……、忍とあの子がいなけれ
　ば、人はこの余生を得ることさえできなかったは
　ずです」
lines.english: “Without her… without Shinobu and that girl, humanity could not have gained even this last lease on life.”

lines.japanese:
「並はずれた演算能力も、そうでなければ説明がつ
　かない……か」
lines.english: “And nothing else would explain that extraordinary processing power…”

lines.japanese:
「もし我々の推測が正しければ、腫瘍はもう消滅し
　ているはずです」
lines.english: “If our hypothesis is correct, the tumor should already have disappeared.”

lines.japanese: 「物理的に消滅していると？」
lines.english: “Physically disappeared?”

lines.japanese:
「自らの組織を紐解き、ズタズタにされた忍の脳神
　経と認識を治療する……」
lines.english: “It unraveled its own tissue to repair Shinobu's shredded neural pathways and cognition…”

lines.japanese:
「知られてはいませんが、神経細胞は蘇生すること
　があるのです」
lines.english: “It isn't widely known, but neurons can sometimes regenerate.”

lines.japanese:
「……確かに忍は体内にＥＳセルという特殊なシス
　テムを接ぎ木してますから……それの応用で確か
　に……しかしそれだけでは」
lines.english: “…Shinobu did have that special system of ES cells grafted into his body. An application of it could certainly… But that alone…”

lines.japanese:
「神経を回復し、そこに自分の記憶を転写すること
　で、記憶の欠落もなくなります」
lines.english: “Restoring the nerves and transferring her memories into them would also eliminate the gaps in his memory.”

lines.japanese:
「あの子が知り得た知識は、ネットのそれをのぞけば
　忍の認知と一致するはずですから」
lines.english: “Aside from what she learned through the network, her knowledge should coincide with Shinobu's own perceptions.”

lines.japanese: 「しかしそれは……」
lines.english: “But that would mean…”

lines.japanese: 「厳密な忍自身の記憶ではないのでしょうね」
lines.english: “Strictly speaking, they would not be Shinobu's own memories.”

lines.japanese:
「…………我々はその種の問題に、踏み込む資格は
　ありませんね」
lines.english: “…………We have no right to intrude upon questions of that nature.”

lines.japanese:
「忍は後日、検査に来させましょう。通常の検査で
　す。何もなければ、彼の件はこれでおしまいです」
lines.english: “We'll have Shinobu come in for an examination later. A routine one. If it finds nothing, his case ends there.”

lines.japanese: 「……登録削除ですか」
lines.english: “…You'll delete his registration?”

lines.japanese: 「もともと抹消されていたキングですから」
lines.english: “His registration as a King had already been erased.”

lines.japanese:
「あとのことは、あなたたちナイトだけで事足りる
　でしょう？」
lines.english: “Surely you Knights will be enough to handle everything that remains?”

lines.japanese: 「……これで、やっとあいつのお守りから解放か」
lines.english: “…At last, I'm free from babysitting that bastard.”

lines.japanese: 「残念そうだな」
lines.english: “You sound disappointed.”

lines.japanese:
「ふざけんな！　俺は……俺は認めてねぇ…………
　俺があいつを……！！」
lines.english: “Screw you! I… I don't accept this… Me… that bastard…!!”

lines.japanese: 「ＵＳＥＲで、あいつを嫌悪できる者はいない」
lines.english: “No USER is capable of hating him.”

lines.japanese:
「模倣子はそれを許さない。おまえの脳内に配線さ
　れた回路に逆らうことはできない」
lines.english: “The mimetic units won't permit it. You cannot defy the circuits wired into your brain.”

lines.japanese:
「本当の気持ちさえ改竄するのが模倣子です。悲し
　いことですが」
lines.english: “Mimetic units rewrite even our true feelings. It is a sad thing.”

lines.japanese:
「……結局、この力ってのも、全部そうやって脳を
　いじられたからだろ」
lines.english: “…So in the end, these powers are all because they tampered with our brains that way.”

lines.japanese:
「あいつを守り従うために、拒絶反応をねじ伏せら
　れて……フェアじゃねぇよ」
lines.english: “They crushed our rejection response so we'd protect and obey him… It isn't fair.”

lines.japanese: 「その通り」
lines.english: “Precisely.”

lines.japanese: 「ああんっ！？」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese:
「……それが、このＧＶＰのコンセプトだったんで
　すよ」
lines.english: “…That was the concept behind the GVP.”

lines.japanese:
「静的侵略手段としての模倣子。脳内への干渉によ
　り、敵性思考そのものを剥奪するという……人類
　規模の洗脳」
lines.english: “Mimetic units as an instrument of static invasion. Interference within the brain would strip away hostile thought itself… brainwashing on the scale of humanity.”

lines.japanese:
「気流に乗り、海中に育まれ、土中に潜む、ありと
　あらゆる仕方で人と人とを連結する終焉の風」
lines.english: “Riding air currents, nurtured in the sea, lying dormant in soil—the wind of the end, linking person to person by every conceivable route.”

lines.japanese:
「……それが、結果として人を連結し、敵を
　生成した」
lines.english: “…And by connecting humanity, it ultimately generated the enemy.”

lines.japanese:
「事前にわかる術がなければ、それも仕方ないこと
　でしょう」
lines.english: “If there was no way to know in advance, perhaps it couldn’t be helped.”

lines.japanese: 「だとしても……気にいらねぇよ」
lines.english: “Even so… I don't like it.”

lines.japanese: 「忍はおまえに感謝していたようだが」
lines.english: “Shinobu seemed grateful to you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　どういうことだ？」
lines.english: “Huh? What does that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「……おまえはあいつを嫌い続けようとしたからな」
lines.english: “…You kept trying to hate him.”

lines.japanese: 「灰野だってそうだった」
lines.english: “So did Haino.”

lines.japanese:
「違う。あれはもう自我崩壊を起こしていた。残さ
　れたのは、かつての渇望……新世界を統べるとい
　う愚かしい欲求の断片でしかない」
lines.english: “No. His ego had already collapsed. All that remained was a fragment of his old craving—the foolish desire to rule the new world.”

lines.japanese:
「……恐らく灰野では、侵攻に対してなすがままだ
　ったはずだ」
lines.english: “…Haino would likely have offered no resistance at all to the invasion.”

lines.japanese: 「能力が下だったからか？」
lines.english: “Because his powers were weaker?”

lines.japanese: 「違う」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「意志を持たなかったからだ」
lines.english: “Because he had no will.”

lines.japanese: 「へ……人形野郎が。感情がある方が強いってか？」
lines.english: “Hah… You damn puppet. You're saying emotions make you stronger?”

lines.japanese: 「そういうことでもない」
lines.english: “Not precisely.”

lines.japanese:
「感情がなければ、矛盾した選択をすることはでき
　ないからだ」
lines.english: “Without emotion, you cannot make a contradictory choice.”

lines.japanese:
「敵が人の意志群からのボトムアップとして生成さ
　れる高次知性だとするなら、その殲滅は人の滅亡
　そのものを意味する」
lines.english: “If the enemy is a higher intelligence generated from the bottom up by the collective will of humanity, then destroying it would mean destroying humanity itself.”

lines.japanese: 「人類そのものの減少だけが、唯一の正解となる」
lines.english: “The only correct answer, then, is to reduce the human population.”

lines.japanese: 「……灰野では、それは選べないってことか？」
lines.english: “…You're saying Haino couldn't make that choice?”

lines.japanese:
「彼の意志は外殻だけで構成されていた……いわば
　空洞人間です。統率するユニットには、人類を保持
　するべく最低限のすり込みが施されます」
lines.english: “His will consisted only of an outer shell… He was, so to speak, a hollow man. Command units receive a minimal imprint to preserve humanity.”

lines.japanese: 「つまり、人を滅ぼすな、とな」
lines.english: “In other words: do not destroy humanity.”

lines.japanese: 「それは倫理とも似ている」
lines.english: “That is akin to ethics.”

lines.japanese: 「…………じゃあ……あいつは……」
lines.english: “…………Then… that bastard…”

lines.japanese:
「おまえも感じたはずだ。あの瞬間、俺たちは確か
　に一つだった」
lines.english: “You must have felt it too. In that moment, we truly were one.”

lines.japanese:
「神の末端であり、忍の一部であり、そして群体だ
　った」
lines.english: “We were terminal nodes of a god, parts of Shinobu, and a collective.”

lines.japanese:
「そして忍の決断……倫理を踏み越えてまで進もう
　という感情の発狂を」
lines.english: “And we felt Shinobu’s decision… the madness of emotion driving him onward, even beyond ethics.”

lines.japanese:
「もし積極的に攻撃していなければ、接続された全
　ての人類は、同時多発的に焼き切れていただろう」
lines.english: “Had we not gone on the offensive, every connected human being would have burned out at once.”

lines.japanese: 「その結果は……知性なき社会」
lines.english: “The result would have been… a society without intelligence.”

lines.japanese: 「フリークスだけが闊歩する、残滓の世界だ」
lines.english: “A world of remnants where only freaks roam.”

lines.japanese: 「だが俺たちには、まだ自意識がある」
lines.english: “But we still possess self-awareness.”

lines.japanese: 「忍の機能喪失とともに、支配力は消滅した」
lines.english: “When Shinobu lost his function, his control disappeared.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたたちは、また個に戻されたんですよ」
lines.english: “You were returned to individual existence.”

lines.japanese: 「…………認めねぇ」
lines.english: “…………I don't accept it.”

lines.japanese: 「俺だけは、認めねぇ……」
lines.english: “I won't accept it… not me…”

lines.japanese:
「構わないが、手は出すなよ。この世のどんな法で
　も、忍は裁けない」
lines.english: “That is your right, but don't touch him. No law in this world can judge Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「…………ああ……わかってんよ……」
lines.english: “…………Yeah… I know…”

lines.japanese: 「実際のところ、あの連中、どうなんです？」
lines.english: “What about the others, though?”

lines.japanese:
「初期から、忍による脳意識への干渉、あったと思
　いますか？」
lines.english: “Do you think Shinobu was interfering with their consciousness from the beginning?”

lines.japanese: 「……斎はどう思います？」
lines.english: “…What do you think, Itsuki?”

lines.japanese: 「あずさはそうだったと思います」
lines.english: “I believe that was true of Azusa.”

lines.japanese:
「ＥＳセルの移植によって、模倣子が直接植え付け
　られましたから」
lines.english: “The ES-cell transplant introduced mimetic units directly into her body.”

lines.japanese:
「実際、行動や認識が忍に対して圧倒的すぎました。
　でも」
lines.english: “Her behavior toward Shinobu, and the way she perceived him, were undeniably extreme. But…”

lines.japanese: 「でも？」
lines.english: “But?”

lines.japanese:
「……そうでなくとも、それ以前から、あずさは忍
　に傾いていたでしょうね」
lines.english: “…Even without that, Azusa was already drawn to Shinobu beforehand.”

lines.japanese: 「刷り込みというやつだ」
lines.english: “Imprinting.”

lines.japanese: 「何の話だ？」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese:
「紅緒あずさはクラスメイトによって長期的な虐待
　……つまりいじめを受けていた」
lines.english: “Azusa Benio suffered prolonged abuse from her classmates… bullying, in other words.”

lines.japanese:
「精神的に不安定だったし、対象の不確かな怒りに
　よって何人かの子供に怪我をさせていた」
lines.english: “She was mentally unstable, and an unfocused anger had led her to injure several children.”

lines.japanese:
「演技とはいえ、最初に縁があったのが忍で……そ
　して奴は対応のミスからあずさに最低限の気遣い
　を示した」
lines.english: “Shinobu was acting, but he was the first to connect with her… Then he made a mistake in his response and showed Azusa the bare minimum of concern.”

lines.japanese:
「関わり合いになりたくなければ、無視するべきだ
　ったのだがな」
lines.english: “If he wanted no involvement with her, he should have ignored her.”

lines.japanese: 「……樋口章二も自分の意志だったはずです」
lines.english: “…Shouji Higuchi must have acted of his own will as well.”

lines.japanese:
「彼はいわゆる、かなり微弱な力しか持たない
　クローズドで、模倣子にも自然感染、計画には
　直接影響しない存在でしたから」
lines.english: “He was what we call a Closed, with only extremely weak abilities. He acquired mimetic units naturally and had no direct bearing on the plan.”

lines.japanese: 「あとは……ナチュラルですか」
lines.english: “That leaves… the Naturals.”

lines.japanese:
「おそらく忍は、必死で彼女たちを感染させないよ
　うに振る舞っていたのでしょう」
lines.english: “Shinobu was probably doing everything he could to keep from infecting them.”

lines.japanese:
「もっとも、それでもこの国に住む限り自然感染は
　避けられないでしょうが……」
lines.english: “Though as long as they lived in this country, natural infection would have been unavoidable…”

lines.japanese: 「印象操作はないでしょうね」
lines.english: “But I doubt there was any impression manipulation.”

lines.japanese: 「……俺は……どうなんだ？」
lines.english: “…What about me?”

lines.japanese: 「どう思う？」
lines.english: “What do you think?”

lines.japanese: 「印象操作ってのは……いったい……」
lines.english: “What the hell do you mean by impression manipulation…?”

lines.japanese:
「忍が意識的に模倣子をコントロールしなければ、
　どんな端末も彼のアクセスを無条件で受け入れる
　ように改造されますから」
lines.english: “Unless Shinobu consciously controlled the mimetic units, any terminal would be modified to accept his access unconditionally.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、奴はおまえを評価していたんだ」
lines.english: “That was why he valued you.”

lines.japanese:
「ウサギの件がなければ、俺のいた位置におまえが
　いたかも知れない」
lines.english: “Had the incident with the rabbit not occurred, you might have stood where I did.”

lines.japanese:
「……冗談じゃねぇ……なんで、惚れた女まで差し
　出して……自分自身まで……！」
lines.english: “…Don't make me laugh… Why would I hand over the woman I loved… even hand over myself…!”

lines.japanese: 「伊月笛子は、おまえの思い人ではない」
lines.english: “Fueko Izuki is not the woman you loved.”

lines.japanese:
「人格を受け継いだんなら、
　半分はそうだろうがよ！」
lines.english: “If she inherited the personality, then she's half the same person!”

lines.japanese:
「……俺は彼女の姉は知らないが、資料からすると
　だいぶ違う人間だぞ」
lines.english: “…I never knew her sister, but according to the records, they were quite different people.”

lines.japanese:
「どれほど克明に人格を複写しても、人の心は情報
　によって最適化されてしまいます」
lines.english: “No matter how precisely a personality is copied, the human mind is optimized by the information it receives.”

lines.japanese:
「姉と妹という肉体の差は、そのまま情報経路の質
　的差となります」
lines.english: “The physical difference between elder and younger sister becomes a qualitative difference in their information pathways.”

lines.japanese: 「１０年も立てば、別人ですよ」
lines.english: “After ten years, they are different people.”

lines.japanese: 「…………わかっては、いますが……」
lines.english: “…………I do understand that…”

lines.japanese: 「……チッ、勝手に言ってろ…………」
lines.english: “…Tch. Say whatever you want…”

lines.japanese: 「唯一、わからなかったのは本堂沙也加ですが」
lines.english: “The only one we couldn’t explain was Sayaka Hondou.”

lines.japanese:
「彼女は……恐らく……忍が生まれなければ、その
　かわりとなっていた自然存在なのではないかと、
　邑西博士は言っていました」
lines.english: “She was… perhaps… a natural being who would have taken Shinobu's place had he never been born. That was Dr. Yuuzai's theory.”

lines.japanese: 「……種が生み出す、情報読解者ですか……」
lines.english: “…An interpreter of information produced by the species…”

lines.japanese:
「我々は機能を付加するために模倣子を撒いた。し
　かし彼女は……天然のそれを用いることができた
　ようです」
lines.english: “We scattered mimetic units to add that function. But she… appears to have been capable of using a natural equivalent.”

lines.japanese: 「天然の？」
lines.english: “A natural equivalent?”

lines.japanese: 「……花粉だ」
lines.english: “…Pollen.”

lines.japanese:
「彼女の生誕と同時に、あの近くの森から発生する
　花粉に異変が起きている。ある種の情報性の増大
　が確認されたんだ」
lines.english: “At the time of her birth, the pollen produced by the nearby forest underwent a change. We confirmed an increase in a kind of informational quality.”

lines.japanese:
「……この花粉という代物、模倣子と非常に似た面
　があると思わないか？」
lines.english: “…Don't you think this pollen bears a striking resemblance to mimetic units?”

lines.japanese:
「どのような地域にも大なり小なり存在し、そして
　生物相の中核となって負う」
lines.english: “It exists to some degree in every region, and lies at the heart of the ecosystem.”

lines.japanese: 「情報を蓄積するのに、適した種だ」
lines.english: “It is well suited to storing information.”

lines.japanese: 「さらにエアロゾル感染性があり、環境耐性がある」
lines.english: “It is also transmissible by aerosol and environmentally resilient.”

lines.japanese: 「そして人間の粘膜に容易に接触する」
lines.english: “And it readily comes into contact with human mucous membranes.”

lines.japanese: 「……あいつも……王だってのか？」
lines.english: “…You're saying she's… a King too?”

lines.japanese:
「忍という人工の王が生まれなければ、恐らく
　は……」
lines.english: “Had the artificial King called Shinobu never been born, then in all probability…”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ報告しなけりゃまずいんじゃねーのか！」
lines.english: “Then shouldn't we be reporting this?!”

lines.japanese: 「……私を誰だと思っているんですか」
lines.english: “…Who do you think I am?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや……所長は……所長で……」
lines.english: “Oh. Uh… you're the director, so…”

lines.japanese: 「一応、本件の最高責任者です」
lines.english: “I am, after all, the person ultimately responsible for this matter.”

lines.japanese:
「ついでに言えば、国家政府の要人でもあらせ
　られる」
lines.english: “And, while we're at it, she also happens to be a personage of great importance to the national government.”

lines.japanese: 「……しかも美しい……」
lines.english: “…And beautiful besides…”

lines.japanese: 「なんだって？」
lines.english: “What was that?”
“Nothing…”

lines.japanese: 「自爆しましたね、斎」
lines.english: “You gave yourself away, Itsuki.”

lines.japanese: 「精進なさい。今はまだ」
lines.english: “Keep working at it. You're not there yet.”
“Yes, ma'am!”
“…Tch.”

lines.japanese: 「にしても、王かよ……道理で……」
lines.english: “Still, a King… That explains a lot…”

lines.japanese: 「彼女はまるで人間に興味がなかったそうだ」
lines.english: “Apparently, she had no interest in human beings whatsoever.”

lines.japanese: 「だが忍との間には盟約を持った」
lines.english: “Yet she formed a covenant with Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「……高次知性、上位知性……おそらくそれは種に
　とって自然の現象なのだろうな」
lines.english: “…Higher intelligence, superordinate intelligence… Perhaps it is simply a natural phenomenon at the level of a species.”

lines.japanese: 「個体数が８０億を越えた時に現れる、接続者……」
lines.english: “A connector who emerges once the population exceeds eight billion…”

lines.japanese:
「……そんな数まで、また増えることができるのか
　よ、俺たち」
lines.english: “…Can our numbers grow that high again?”

lines.japanese:
「あと数千年も、生き延びることができれば……あ
　るいは……」
lines.english: “If we can survive for another several thousand years… perhaps…”

lines.japanese:
「忍はわかったんだろうな、それが。だから接触し
　た。彼女のような人の倫理を阻害された者は、ゆ
　えに忍にとっては絶対的な他者だった」
lines.english: “Shinobu must have understood that. That is why he sought her out. Someone like her, whose human morality had been stunted, was by that very fact an absolute other to him.”

lines.japanese:
「……恋は、自分とするものではありません。だから
　こそ忍は、繋がりたいと願う反面、他者を求めた」
lines.english: “…One does not fall in love with oneself. And so, even as Shinobu longed for connection, he also sought someone other than himself.”

lines.japanese:
「結果として、仲間を過剰なまでに遠ざけたがった
　んです」
lines.english: “As a result, he wanted to keep his companions at far too great a distance.”

lines.japanese:
「しかし、沙也加はなぜ人の形を取ったので
　しょうね」
lines.english: “But why, I wonder, did Sayaka take human form?”

lines.japanese:
「森の奥に、異質な樹木があるんだが……おそらく
　あれが本来のアンテナだったのだろうな」
lines.english: “There is an anomalous tree deep in the forest… That was probably the original antenna.”

lines.japanese:
「彼女にとっては適応放散システムだったんだろ
　う。あの木の花粉散布量と生産機能は、群を抜
　いている」
lines.english: “For her, it must have been a system of adaptive radiation. The volume of pollen that tree disperses, and its productive capacity, are both in a class of their own.”

lines.japanese:
「また対Ｕガス……模倣子の伝達を阻害する働きの
　あるこのガスも、森の花粉をもとに研究されたも
　のだ」
lines.english: “And anti-U gas… a gas that inhibits the transmission of mimetic units… was itself developed through research on the forest's pollen.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなのかよ？」
lines.english: “Seriously?”

lines.japanese:
「そもそも、模倣子の研究自体が花粉から着想を得
　たものですから」
lines.english: “Research into mimetic units was inspired by pollen in the first place.”

lines.japanese:
「だがその機能に特化するあまり、不都合もあった
　のだろう。こと演算をするという面においては、
　植物より人間が適していることもある」
lines.english: “But specialization in that function must have brought its own disadvantages. Where computation is concerned, a human being may sometimes be better suited than a plant.”

lines.japanese:
「知性の総意のような形で、最適な個体が選ばれた
　のではないかと思う」
lines.english: “I suspect the optimal individual was selected by something like the collective will of that intelligence.”

lines.japanese:
「なあ……もし、あの敵が……内ではなく外に向か
　っていたら……どうなったんだ？」
lines.english: “Hey… If that enemy had turned outward instead of inward… what would have happened?”

lines.japanese:
「邑西先生からの受け売りだが……人類はそのまま
　存続したはずだ」
lines.english: “I'm only repeating what Dr. Yuuzai said… but humanity would presumably have continued to exist unchanged.”

lines.japanese: 「おそらく、上位知性の存在など気づきもしないで」
lines.english: “We probably never would have noticed that higher intelligence existed.”

lines.japanese: 「……向かった先は？」
lines.english: “…Where was it headed?”

lines.japanese: 「それは忍しか見ていないでしょう」
lines.english: “Shinobu is surely the only one who saw that.”

lines.japanese:
「あるいは……あの子だったら、何か知っていたか
　も知れません」
lines.english: “Or perhaps… that child might have known something about it.”

lines.japanese: 「イマジナリーネット管理人、イマ、ですか」
lines.english: “Ima, administrator of the Imaginary Net?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ……一度、対話をしてみたかった」
lines.english: “Yes… I would have liked to speak with her once.”

lines.japanese:
「忍の人格の一部だと思ってしまったことが……
　失敗でしたね」
lines.english: “Our mistake… was assuming that she was merely one facet of Shinobu's personality.”

lines.japanese:
「もっとも、人類最高の使い手が自らの存在を誤魔
　化したのですから、我々で暴けたかどうか」
lines.english: “Then again, when humanity's greatest wielder conceals her own existence, could the likes of us ever have uncovered her?”

lines.japanese: 「人類、ですか」
lines.english: “Humanity's, you say?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、そう思っています」
lines.english: “Yes. That is what I believe.”

lines.japanese: 「……本望でしょう、彼女も」
lines.english: “…I'm sure it was what she wanted too.”

lines.japanese: 「彼女？」
lines.english: “She?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「自分で言ったぞ、彼女、と」
lines.english: “You said it yourself. ‘She.’”

lines.japanese:
「あなたは、腫瘍存在と接触したことがあるの
　ですか？」
lines.english: “Have you ever come into contact with the tumorous entity?”

lines.japanese:
「いえ、ないはずです……なぜそんなことを口にし
　たのかも……はて、とんと……」
lines.english: “No. I don't believe I have… Nor can I say why the word came to me… How strange…”

lines.japanese: 「あるいは……」
lines.english: “Unless…”

lines.japanese:
「彼女は我々が思うよりずっと、そばにいたのかも
　知れませんよ」
lines.english: “Perhaps she was much closer to us than any of us ever imagined.”

lines.japanese: 「観測者、ですか」
lines.english: “An observer, then?”

lines.japanese:
「何を思い、何を自分と定め、そして
　去ったのか……」
lines.english: “What did she think… what did she take to be herself… before she left?”

lines.japanese: 「……交差点でしたね、多くの種と知性にとって」
lines.english: “…It was a crossroads, for so many species and intelligences.”

lines.japanese:
「時代の境目でした。しかしそれはまだ終わっては
　いません」
lines.english: “It was the boundary between two ages. But it has not come to an end yet.”

lines.japanese:
「楽しそうだな、あの連中。ジーンを連れてこなく
　て正解だ。飛び込んで、ご破算にしかねない」
lines.english: “They look like they're having fun. Good thing we didn't bring Gene. She might charge in and ruin the whole thing.”

lines.japanese:
「……沙也加に殺されるぞ……
　そんなことをしたら……」
lines.english: “…Sayaka would kill her… if she tried anything like that…”

lines.japanese: 「だから閉じこめてきたんだ」
lines.english: “Which is why I locked her up.”

lines.japanese:
「ふざけんなーーーーー！！
　これが功績者の扱いかーーーーー！！」
lines.english: “You bastards! Is this how you treat a hero?!”

lines.japanese:
「開けろー！　開けてー！
　お願い開けてーーーーーーっ！！」
lines.english: “Open up! Let me out! Please, open this dooooooor!”

lines.japanese:
「パーティー！！
　ヤキニク・パーティーーー！！」
lines.english: “The party! The barbecue paaaaaarty!”

lines.japanese: 「欧米人に肉は危険だ。与えない方がいい」
lines.english: “Meat is dangerous for Westerners. Better not to give her any.”

lines.japanese: 「貴重品ですからね、今は」
lines.english: “It is a luxury these days.”

lines.japanese:
「戻らなくていいのか、斎？
　もう大事はないと見ていいだろう。加わって、
　再会を喜んだらどうだ？」
lines.english: “Aren't you going back, Itsuki? I think we can safely say the crisis has passed. Why not join them and celebrate your reunion?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえの主君だろう」
lines.english: “He is your liege lord, after all.”

lines.japanese: 「……時代がかりやがって、骨董野郎が」
lines.english: “…What century are you from, you antique?”

lines.japanese: 「……俺はもう、戻らない」
lines.english: “…I'm not going back.”

lines.japanese: 「いいのか？」
lines.english: “Are you sure?”

lines.japanese: 「妹に任せた。あとはうまくやるさ」
lines.english: “I left it to my sister. She'll manage.”

lines.japanese:
「あいつはカラッポだった自分に、いろいろなもの
　を詰めてくれた忍を好いているからな」
lines.english: “She is fond of Shinobu, who filled her empty self with so many things.”

lines.japanese: 「……あいつは電波女だ」
lines.english: “…She's a space cadet.”

lines.japanese:
「あいつにとって、他に幸せを感じる手段はなかっ
　たはずだ。俺の分まで、仕えてもらうさ」
lines.english: “She probably had no other way of finding happiness. She can serve him in my place as well.”

lines.japanese: 「それに……これからは、俺にもやることがある」
lines.english: “Besides… I have work of my own to do now.”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだな」
lines.english: “…That you do.”

lines.japanese: 「この町を離れられると思うとせいせいするぜ」
lines.english: “I'll be damn glad to get out of this town.”

lines.japanese: 「その件ですが」
lines.english: “About that.”

lines.japanese:
「模倣子分布率の回復にともない、残存能力者の再
　編制を行う予定です」
lines.english: “As the distribution of mimetic units recovers, we intend to reorganize the surviving wielders.”

lines.japanese: 「力もだいぶ回復したしな」
lines.english: “Our abilities have recovered considerably as well.”

lines.japanese:
「そういや、貴宮はポシャッたのに力が使えるって
　のは、おかしい話だな」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, Atemiya's out of commission, but we can still use our powers. That's pretty strange.”

lines.japanese: 「そのように調整しましたので」
lines.english: “Because I adjusted matters to make it so.”

lines.japanese:
「今の模倣子は、管理権限抑制因子を組み込んだ
　タイプですから」
lines.english: “The current mimetic units incorporate an inhibitor for administrative authority.”

lines.japanese:
「……それは、誰でも制限なく力を行使できる、と？
　危険では？」
lines.english: “…Meaning anyone can wield their abilities without restriction? Is that not dangerous?”

lines.japanese: 「現実世界のネットはどうでしたか？」
lines.english: “How did the real-world internet fare?”

lines.japanese:
「……ふむ、使用者たちの善意に委ねられていたわ
　りには、だな」
lines.english: “…Hmm. Considering it was entrusted to the good faith of its users, it did rather well.”

lines.japanese:
「人が１０人いりゃあ、悪党より小心者の方が多い。
　そういうこったろ」
lines.english: “Get ten people in a room and you'll have more cowards than villains. That's all it means.”

lines.japanese:
「……悪意ある能力者についても、今後は対処が必
　要になるな」
lines.english: “…Even so, we will need some means of dealing with malicious wielders from now on.”

lines.japanese:
「現存する人類に、ネットを統括できるレベルの知
　性は存在しませんから」
lines.english: “No intellect capable of governing the network exists among the humans who remain.”

lines.japanese: 「……なるほどな」
lines.english: “…I see.”

lines.japanese:
「一年経ち、国内のフリークスもだいぶ落ち着きま
　した」
lines.english: “A year has passed, and the freaks within the country have largely quieted down.”

lines.japanese:
「しかし生活性や潜伏期のある個体も多く、予断を
　許さない状況です」
lines.english: “But many specimens remain active, while others have latent periods. We cannot afford to relax our guard.”

lines.japanese:
「高度な判断が必要となる今後は、より組織立てた
　治安維持が必要になります」
lines.english: “The complex judgments ahead will require a more organized approach to maintaining public order.”

lines.japanese:
「ユーラシア派遣部隊から、本格的に回収物資運搬
　の手はずが整ってな。今後はヘリも燃料を気にせ
　ず使える」
lines.english: “The Eurasian expeditionary force has finally put arrangements in place for full-scale transport of recovered supplies. From now on, we can use helicopters without worrying about fuel.”

lines.japanese:
「となれば、拠点自体も霞ヶ浦あたりを接収しては
　どうかという話でな」
lines.english: “That being the case, there is talk of requisitioning a site around Kasumigaura for the base itself.”

lines.japanese:
「……ようやくバックアップが受けられるのかよ。
　おせぇよ」
lines.english: “…So we're finally getting backup? About damn time.”

lines.japanese:
「仕方がない。混乱を鎮圧するだけで精一杯だった
　んだからな」
lines.english: “It couldn't be helped. They had their hands full just bringing the chaos under control.”

lines.japanese: 「そのようなわけで、俺も参加させてくれ」
lines.english: “In that case, allow me to take part as well.”

lines.japanese: 「……お願いします」
lines.english: “…Please do.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ」
lines.english: “Yes, ma'am.”

lines.japanese: 「太閤閣下ともしばしの別れだな」
lines.english: “So you'll be bidding His Excellency the Regent farewell for a while.”

lines.japanese:
「身の回りが静かになるのは良いでしょう。
　それに、これは私たちの仕事です」
lines.english: “A little peace and quiet will do me good. Besides, this is our work.”

lines.japanese:
「……いいなら、今日からでも検討に入るが。
　時間は節約したい」
lines.english: “…If you're sure, we can start making arrangements today. We have no time to waste.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、了解した」
lines.english: “Understood.”

lines.japanese: 「加速処置の方は平気ですか？」
lines.english: “Are you tolerating the acceleration procedure?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。問題なく」
lines.english: “Yes. No problems.”

lines.japanese: 「伊勢崎宗多、あなたは？」
lines.english: “Souta Isezaki. And you?”

lines.japanese: 「……平気です」
lines.english: “…I'm fine.”

lines.japanese: 「よし、なら行こう。あがくのだ」
lines.english: “Good. Then let's go. We'll struggle on.”

lines.japanese: 「せいぜい、堕落するんだな、貴宮―――」
lines.english: “Go ahead and sink into depravity, Atemiya—”

lines.japanese:
この日を最後に、僕の周囲から何人かの人間が、
姿を消した。
lines.english: After that day, several people vanished from my life.

lines.japanese: 彼らがどこに行き、何をしているのか。
lines.english: Where they went, and what they are doing now—

lines.japanese:
推測することは容易いが、きっとそれは、今の僕
には踏み込めない世界なのだろう。
lines.english: It would be easy enough to guess, but theirs is probably a world I cannot enter as I am now.

lines.japanese:
良くも悪くも、僕のしたことは大きすぎる。
　それは到底、人の倫理ではかれば裁けず。
lines.english: For better or worse, what I did was too vast in scale. It cannot possibly be judged by human ethics.

lines.japanese:
自分のした行為に結論が出るのは、あるいは人が
生き延びる数世紀先のことになるはずだ。
lines.english: A verdict on my actions may not come for centuries—assuming humanity survives that long.

lines.japanese: だから今は、明日を楽しみに日々責任をとり続ける。
lines.english: So for now, I take responsibility day after day, while looking forward to tomorrow.

lines.japanese: 罪に償いはできない。
lines.english: There can be no atoning for my sins.

lines.japanese:
が、責任を取ることはできるのだ。
　取り続けることでのみ、それは成立する。
lines.english: But I can take responsibility for them. Only by continuing to do so can that responsibility mean anything.

lines.japanese:
僕の傷つけた彼女たちとの暮らしは、楽しすぎて
……お祭りのようにさえ思える。
lines.english: Life with the girls I hurt is so much fun that sometimes… it feels almost like a festival.

lines.japanese: だけど僕は忘れない。
lines.english: But I will not forget.

lines.japanese:
失ったものを。
　潰えたものを。
lines.english: What was lost. What was destroyed.

lines.japanese:
自身の決断と行為と結果を。
　かくのごとく記録し、送信し続けよう。
lines.english: My own decisions, actions, and their consequences. I will go on recording and transmitting them in this way.

lines.japanese: 沙也加は言った。
lines.english: Sayaka once told me this:

lines.japanese:
世界は無数の記録でできている、と。
　模倣子以外の媒体が生じうる余地があるのだと。
lines.english: The world is made of countless records. There may yet be room for a medium other than mimetic units to arise.

lines.japanese: 僕はその考えを信じる。
lines.english: I believe that.

lines.japanese:
今まで生まれ、死んだ全ての生命が、どこかに記
録されているかも知れないのだ。
lines.english: Every life ever born, and every life that died, may have been recorded somewhere.

lines.japanese: 救われる考えだ。
lines.english: I find comfort in that thought.

lines.japanese:
そして上位の知性は、そんな矮小な僕らの意志など
解することなく、上へ上へとかけていくのだろう。
lines.english: And the higher intelligences, without understanding wills as small as ours, will probably race higher and higher still.

lines.japanese:
上位知性の集合によって、より高位の知性が……
　なんてのは……夢幻の事象である。
lines.english: Higher intelligences joining to form a still higher intelligence… But that is the stuff of dreams.

lines.japanese:
彼らが僕らを気にしないよう、僕も彼らを気にし
ない。
lines.english: Just as they pay us no mind, I will pay them none.

lines.japanese:
今はただ、彼女たちとの暮らしを維持するだけで
ある。
lines.english: For now, all that matters is preserving the life I have with the girls.

lines.japanese: きっと、これからも。
lines.english: And surely that will remain true.

lines.japanese:
ただほんの少しだけ、心配というか懸念というか
罪悪感というか。
lines.english: There is just one tiny worry—or misgiving, or twinge of guilt.

lines.japanese:
「……まるで……ハーレムエンドなんだよな……コレ
　…………いいのか？」
lines.english: “…This is basically… a harem ending, isn't it…? …………Is this really okay?”

lines.japanese: 働こうとすると止められるし。
lines.english: They stop me whenever I try to work.

lines.japanese:
一人で入る風呂が懐かしいとか、自分でするとき
にはどういう順番で体を洗っていたんだっけとか、
そういう罪深い状況だ。
lines.english: I miss bathing alone. I've even forgotten where I used to start when I washed myself. It's a sinful state of affairs.

lines.japanese: ああ、ＯＫＯＫ、皆まで言わないでもわかる。
lines.english: All right, all right. I know what you're going to say.

lines.japanese:
どうか、この記録を見つけた人。
　遠慮なく僕を呪って欲しい。
lines.english: Whoever finds this record, please—curse me all you like.

lines.japanese:
甘んじて受けます、ハイ。
　僕の言いたいことはそれだけだ。
lines.english: Yes, I will meekly accept every last curse. That is all I have to say on the subject.

lines.japanese:
さて、アスの残したサイトの更新も、いよいよこ
れが最後になる。
lines.english: Well, then. This will be my final update to the site Asu left behind.

lines.japanese:
しぼんだネットだから、閲覧できる人がいるのか
どうか……。
lines.english: The network has withered away, so I have no idea whether anyone is even able to see this…

lines.japanese:
でも、もし今後人が増えて、模倣子の存在を利用
できているなら……きっとあなたはこれを読む。
lines.english: But if the human population grows again, and if you have found a way to make use of mimetic units… then someday, you will read this.

lines.japanese:
どうだったろうか？
　考えるところはあったろうか？
lines.english: So, what did you think? Did it give you anything to ponder?

lines.japanese: 僕の罪については？
lines.english: What do you think of my sins?

lines.japanese: 沙也加の存在については？
lines.english: Of Sayaka's existence?

lines.japanese: “彼”とアスについては？
lines.english: Of ‘him,’ and of Asu?

lines.japanese: 世界は今より紐解かれているだろうか？
lines.english: Do you understand more of the world than we do now?

lines.japanese:
平和だろうか？
　不穏だろうか？
　人類は何人？
lines.english: Is it peaceful? Is there trouble on the horizon? How many human beings are there?

lines.japanese:
個人的には、人と人の距離についてなんてどうだ
ろう？
lines.english: On a more personal level, what has become of the distance between one person and another?

lines.japanese: けっこう面白い論文が書けそうな勢いじゃないか。
lines.english: It sounds like the makings of a fascinating paper, don't you think?

lines.japanese: まあどんな形であれ、参考になれば嬉しい。
lines.english: Whatever form it takes, I'll be glad if any of this proves useful.

lines.japanese:
もっとも僕のしたことは、全体に目を通してこう
して後書きを残すことだけだったりする。
lines.english: Though all I actually did was read through the whole thing and leave this afterword at the end.

lines.japanese:
大枠はアスが組んだものをそのまま残してある。
　無論、謎はいくつか残っている。
lines.english: I left the overall structure exactly as Asu built it. Naturally, a few mysteries remain.

lines.japanese:
たとえばメールボックスに入っている、北海道か
らのラブコールだ。
lines.english: For instance, there is that amorous appeal from Hokkaido sitting in the mailbox.

lines.japanese:
なんだっけこれ？
　どこかで掠め見た気もするが、思い出せない。
　内容も高密度過ぎて断片的にしか読めない……。
lines.english: What was that about again? I feel as though I glimpsed it somewhere, but I can't remember. It's too densely packed for me to read more than fragments…

lines.japanese:
愛とかオフ会とかわけがわからない。
　何がしたいんだろう……？
lines.english: Love? An offline meeting? None of it makes any sense. What are they trying to do…?

lines.japanese: まあいいか。
lines.english: Oh, well.

lines.japanese:
格好良くしめたいが、気のきいた言葉も思いつか
ない。
lines.english: I would like to end on a stirring note, but I can't think of anything clever to say.

lines.japanese: なんだろう……そうだな……。
lines.english: What could I…? Ah. Yes…

lines.japanese:
僕は読むことはできないだろうけど（たぶんその
頃には死んでると思う）、一つ質問をさせてもらおう。
lines.english: I probably won’t be able to read your answer (I expect I’ll be dead by then), but let me ask you one question.

lines.japanese: 明日は、楽しみですか？
lines.english: Are you looking forward to tomorrow?

lines.japanese: こちらは、今日も風が吹いてる。
lines.english: The wind is blowing here today, too.

lines.japanese: きっと明日も、吹くと思う―――
lines.english: I think it'll be blowing tomorrow, too—
